title: Human Resources Business Partner
description:
Job Responsibilities:As a key member of the local Human Resources team, you will be responsible for executing day-to-day HR operations with accuracy and compliance. This role ensures smooth employee lifecycle management and supports a positive employee experience.

1.Employee Onboarding & Offboarding:Manage end-to-end new hire onboarding, including document collection, system entry, and orientation coordination.Process employee resignations and terminations, conduct exit interviews, complete clearance procedures, and maintain accurate records in compliance with CLT regulations.

2.Employment Contract Management:Prepare, issue, renew, and archive employment contracts in accordance with Brazilian labor laws (CLT).Track probation periods and support performance evaluation processes.

3.Attendance & Timekeeping Administration:Monitor daily attendance using electronic time clock systems (e.g., Ponto Eletrônico). Review overtime, absences, leaves, and schedule adjustments. Collaborate with department heads to validate monthly attendance data.

4.Payroll Support & Social Contributions:Assist in monthly payroll processing, including calculation of salaries, bonuses, deductions, and overtime.Handle statutory contributions such as FGTS, INSS, and IRRF — ensuring accurate reporting and timely payments.Coordinate with internal finance or external payroll providers to ensure error-free disbursement.

5.New Employee Orientation:Deliver basic onboarding training sessions covering company policies, workplace rules, HR systems, and safety guidelines.Support new hires in integrating into the team and understanding their roles.

6.HR Data & Record Keeping:Maintain up-to-date employee master data, personnel files, and HR databases.Ensure confidentiality and compliance in all HR documentation and system entries.

Qualifications & Requirements:

1.Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.

2.Minimum 2 years of hands-on HR experience in a Brazilian company or multinational environment.

3.Solid understanding of Brazilian labor legislation (Consolidação das Leis do Trabalho – CLT).

4.Employee onboarding and offboarding.Employment contract administration.Attendance tracking and timekeeping systems (e.g., TOTVS, Senior, Oracle, etc.).Payroll support and social tax/filing (INSS, FGTS, IRRF)

5.Detail-oriented, organized, and reliable with strong execution skills.

6.Experience in conducting training or employee engagement activities.

7.Fluently English for business communication.

title: Tech Lead Mobile (Flutter)
description:

Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de software.

Desejável:

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento nativo (Kotlin/Swift) e comunicação via Platform Channels.
  • Publicação e manutenção de aplicativos nas lojas oficiais.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias Ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).

title: NetSuite Accountant
description:

About Us

We are a dynamic and growing U.S.-based accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for a Staff Accountant with NetSuite experience and strong process enhancement and implementation skills to join our remote team. If you're detail-oriented and passionate about financial reporting, budgeting, and variance analysis, this is your chance to work with top-tier US clients.

MIT — Most Important Thing

The Staff Accountant is responsible for following the TGG Way standards for processing and implementing the day-to-day transactional accounting to produce complete and accurate financial statements. The Staff Accountant is required to build and maintain positive relationships with clients, clients’ staff, co-workers, and managers. Understanding source documents, inputting them, and filing them correctly is a key part of the Staff Accountant’s job. Using critical thinking and having a proficiency in intermediate accounting, the Staff Accountant is responsible for the accurate data entry of all transactions into the accounting system.

Responsibilities

  • Accounts Payable & Receivable: Processing invoices, applying payments, and reconciling transactions accurately and efficiently.
  • Bank & Credit Card Reconciliations: Performing soft reconciliations weekly and hard reconciliations monthly, ensuring accuracy in coding and matching transactions. Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and intercompany accounts in NetSuite .
  • Month-End Workbooks: Preparing and reconciling schedules for various accounts such as AR, AP, payroll accruals, loans, and fixed assets. Execute timely and accurate month-end close processes under tight deadlines.
  • Financial Reporting: Mapping accounts, syncing data, and generating financial reports using TGG templates. Analyze and review month-over-month income statements, making necessary adjustments (e.g., prepaid expenses, accrued expenses, fixed assets, and managing cash flow).
  • NetSuite: Utilize NetSuite for bank feeds, reconciliations, accounts payable and receivable processing, generating reports, and posting journal entries. This includes running balance sheets and profit & loss reports, entering invoices and bills, and creating customers and vendors.
  • Communication and Task Management: Using Asana to update and manage tasks and Bizinta for time entries with detailed descriptions.

Requirements

  • 2–3 years of accounting or finance experience doing month-end close processes, bank reconciliations, and intercompany transactions.
  • Education: Accounting or Finance degree preferred.
  • Technical Knowledge: Strong proficiency in NetSuite (or similar ERP) and Excel.
  • Strong background in process enhancement, process implementation, and system optimization.
  • Communication: Fluent in English, both written and spoken, with excellent attention to detail and analytical skills.
  • Strong understanding of debits/credits, journal entries, and accrual-based accounting.
  • US GAAP knowledge required; IFRS familiarity is a plus.
  • Experience working with European entities is a plus.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with a remote team.
  • Working Equipment to start is required.
  • Working hours based on client

Perks & Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO Policy, including all Holidays.
  • 1 Month of Paid training in advanced accounting, U.S. GAAP, and NetSuite.
  • Full access to TGG University and learning materials.
  • Career development through mentoring, training, and long-term growth opportunities.

About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.

Our Core Values

  • Loyalty
  • Integrity
  • Strong Work Ethic
  • Forward Thinking – Growth Mindset
  • Team Player / Caring / Selfless
  • Positive Energy – People who have fun, smile, and laugh
  • Freedom & Accountability

title: Production Supervisor/Coordinator - Dry-Mix Mortar & Water-based Coatings Factory
description:
Core Responsibilities:

1. Production Operations & Management

  • Oversee daily production management for both dry-mix mortar and water-based coatings lines. Schedule production tasks according to plan, ensuring production targets are met on time, in quantity, and to quality standards.
  • Supervise the entire production process from material preparation, feeding, and mixing to packaging and palletizing, ensuring smooth and efficient operations at all stages.
  • Strictly execute the production schedule, optimize production cycle times, and improve equipment utilization and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).

2. Team Management & Development

  • Manage daily shift operations, including personnel scheduling, task assignment, work guidance, and on-site discipline supervision.
  • Organize and implement job skill training to enhance team members' operational skills, quality awareness, and safety mindset.
  • Conduct performance evaluations for shift personnel, providing continuous feedback and coaching to build a high-performance team.

3. Quality Management & Control

  • Strictly enforce standard operating procedures and work instructions to ensure process standardization and stability.
  • Monitor in-line product quality, perform regular checks at key quality control points, and prevent the occurrence of batch quality issues.
  • Collaborate with the Quality department to analyze, address, and track quality deviations in production, and implement corrective and preventive actions.

4. Safety Production & 5S Management

  • Act as the primary safety responsible person for the shift, implementing company safety rules and regulations, organizing safety training, and conducting hazard identification.
  • Ensure all employees strictly adhere to safe operating procedures, particularly those related to dust explosion prevention and chemical handling, to eliminate safety accidents.
  • Promote and maintain 5S management in the production area, creating a clean, orderly, and safe working environment.

5. Cost Control & Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor and analyze the consumption of raw materials, energy, and auxiliary supplies, striving to reduce production costs.
  • Assist in analyzing equipment failure causes to reduce unplanned downtime.
  • Proactively identify waste in the production process, actively participate in and lead continuous improvement activities (e.g., Kaizen), and propose合理化建议 (rationalization suggestions).

Mandatory Requirements:

  • College diploma or above in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Inorganic Non-metallic Materials, or related fields.
  • Minimum 5 years of production experience in the building materials industry, including at least 2 years in a Production Team Leader or Supervisor role. Must have production management experience in a dry-mix mortar or water-based coatings factory.
  • Familiar with the production processes, equipment principles, and operational procedures for dry-mix mortar/coatings (e.g., mixers, automatic packing machines, powder conveying systems, liquid mixing & dispersing equipment).
  • Strong team leadership, communication, coordination, and on-site problem-solving skills.
  • Strong quality awareness, cost consciousness, and safety mindset.
  • Ability to adapt to a factory work environment and handle work pressure.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior work experience with Sika or Saint-Gobain is highly preferred.

title: Arquiteto de Soluções
description:
Sobre a FourD :

Nosso propósito é apoiar nossos clientes na implementação de produtos financeiros e em melhorias de jornadas. Trabalhamos com NuBank, Banco Next e Natura Pay...

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Estamos em busca de um Arquitetura TI para liderar a definição e implementação de arquiteturas tecnológicas que suportem a estratégia de negócios da empresa. Este profissional desempenhará um papel tático essencial, garantindo que as decisões arquiteturais e escolhas tecnológicas estejam alinhadas com os objetivos estratégicos da organização. Além disso, será responsável por influenciar a visão tecnológica da empresa, assegurando que as soluções sejam inovadoras, escaláveis e seguras, ao mesmo tempo em que promovem a eficiência operacional e a governança de TI.

Quais serão suas principais entregas?

• Modelos de referência e diretrizes arquiteturais para desenvolvimento e infraestrutura

• Arquitetura documentada e alinhada às estratégias de negócio

• Roadmap de evolução tecnológica e inovação para os sistemas da empresa

• Estrutura de governança para garantir conformidade e boas práticas

• Planos de modernização e migração de sistemas legados para cloud

• Estratégias de integração e interoperabilidade entre diferentes plataformas

• Relatórios e recomendações sobre novas tecnologias e tendências do mercado

Como será o seu dia a dia?

• Garantir que os direcionamentos com as visões de referência, patterns, ADR, estratégias, estão sendo seguidos e medir o nível de aderência

• Comunicar ideias complexas de maneira clara e eficaz, promovendo a colaboração entre os membros da tribo

• Trazer novas ideias e abordagens para melhorar processos e produtos, alinhando as decisões técnicas com os objetivos de negócios, documentando nas arquiteturas de referência e visões arquiteturais a serem seguidas.

• Influenciar a direção técnica e contribuir para o sucesso a longo prazo da organização.

• Melhorar a eficiência e a qualidade dos produtos e processos, garantindo a aderência às melhores práticas e padrões técnicos.

• Trabalhar proativamente para a escalabilidade e a resiliência do sistema, garantindo que a solução cresça de forma sustentável e adaptável às necessidades do negócio.

Requisitos e qualificações:

• Experiência de atuação com equipes de Engenharia/Arquitetura

• Experiência com equipes ágeis, profundo conhecimento e familiaridade com as cerimônias, métricas e processos mais relevantes do mindset ágil

• Profundo nível de entendimento técnico, capaz de participar de discussões de arquitetura com engenheiros e construir as visões de Arquitetura em nível técnico e estratégico

• Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Análise de Sistemas ou áreas relacionadas

• Experiência prévia como desenvolvedor, engenheiro, tech lead ou arquiteto

• Conhecimento em linguagens de programação (Python, Java, GO, etc.) e principais frameworks (Springboot, Quarkus, etc.)

• Domínio de Design Patterns, Antipatterns, SOLID, Clean Code e etc.

• Entendimento e domínio da disciplina de Arquitetura (Soluções e Corporativa) e design de software (Hexagonal, Onion, Clean Architecture, Layered Architecture, etc.)

• Experiência com estilos arquiteturais (Monolith, Plugin, SOA, Microservices, Event-Driven, etc.)

• Experiência comprovada em arquitetura de TI, incluindo cloud computing (AWS, Azure ou GCP), microsserviços, APIs e integrações

• Conhecimento em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL

• Familiaridade com protocolos de integração (RESTful, gRPC, GraphQL, Web Socket, etc)

• Conhecimento em tópicos relacionados a segurança da informação (camadas de proteção, modelos de autenticação, autorização, criptografia, WAF, etc)

• Conhecimento em computação distribuída, cloud computing, infraestrutura e redes

• Experiência com cultura DevSecOps e automação

• Conhecimento em orquestração de containers (Kubernetes, EKS)

• Conhecimento em observabilidade (ex: SLA, SLI e SLO, Dora metrics e SRE)

• Conhecimento em qualidade de software (testes unitários, testes integrados e funcionais, TDD/BDD, etc)

Diferencial

• Certificações em cloud (AWS Solution Architect, Azure Solutions Architect, Google Professional Cloud Architect)

• Experiência com plataformas de Observabilidade (Datadog, Dynatrace, Grafana, etc.)

Modelo

Híbrido 3x na semana

PJ + Benefícios

Keeta, a subsidiária internacional da Meituan - a gigante global de entregas - tem a missão de revolucionar a entrega de alimentos e produtos de consumo em todo o mundo. Com nossa crença principal: “Ajudamos as pessoas a comer melhor, viver melhor”, estamos levando a inovação para o palco global!

  • Sólidas habilidades de negociação comercial e desenvolvimento de mercado, com capacidade de entender as necessidades dos clientes e promover parcerias comerciais.
  • Honestidade, integridade, excelentes habilidades de comunicação, execução e colaboração, bem como um forte senso de trabalho em equipe.

Não se trata apenas de um emprego, mas de uma oportunidade inigualável para crescimento pessoal, valorização profissional e inovação em escala global.

title: QA Funcional "981998"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

Analisar requisitos funcionais e técnicos para identificar cenários de teste;

Criar, revisar e executar casos de teste manuais e automatizados;

Realizar testes funcionais, exploratórios, de regressão e aceitação;

title: Strategy Market Intelligence Manager
description:
About Keeta

Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan , a global giant in the delivery sector, and it's on an ambitious mission: to revolutionize the delivery of food and consumer goods worldwide. Our motto is simple yet powerful: “We help people eat better, live better.” Guided by this principle, we bring innovation and technology to the global stage. With over 1,000 team members around the world , Keeta is in full expansion — and you could be part of this journey!

Know more: Keeta Website

Location : 100% on site - Vila Olimpia, SP

Overview

This role combines deep user research with market intelligence to provide a holistic view of the food delivery landscape. You will uncover how customers think, feel, and behave — and how the broader market operates — to guide product innovation, pricing strategies, marketing campaigns, and operational improvements. Your insights will help the company anticipate trends, identify growth opportunities, and deliver exceptional value to users.

Key Responsibilities

User Research

  • Conduct qualitative and quantitative studies to understand ordering behavior, satisfaction drivers, and pain points.
  • Build and maintain user personas and journey maps tailored to different customer segments.
  • Measure the impact of app experience, promotions, delivery speed, and fees on retention and conversion.
  • Collaborate with product teams to design and analyze A/B tests and usability studies.
  • Track and report on satisfaction metrics (e.g., NPS, CSAT, order repeat rate).

Market Research

  • Monitor market dynamics, including consumer preferences, pricing trends, and service innovations.
  • Analyze market share distribution, regional demand patterns, and promotional strategies across the industry.
  • Identify unmet needs and whitespace opportunities through benchmarking and customer feedback.
  • Prepare market research reports to support product, marketing, and operations teams.
  • Track industry trends, emerging technologies, and shifts in consumer behavior within food delivery and adjacent sectors.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with data analytics, marketing, product, and operations teams to integrate insights into decision-making.
  • Present findings to leadership in clear, actionable formats (dashboards, briefs, presentations).
  • Support go-to-market strategies for new features or service expansions.

Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Marketing, Data Analytics, Economics, or related field.
  • Fluent in English, with the ability to collaborate across international teams.
  • Experience in market research, consumer insights, or strategic analysis; experience in FMCG, e-commerce, or logistics is a strong plus.
  • Background in top-tier management consulting is preferred.
  • Strong business acumen with excellent communication and storytelling skills.
  • Proven ability to thrive in fast-paced, competitive industries.
  • Experience designing and interpreting research studies, surveys, and behavioral data.

title: Consultor(a) de Preparo de Madeiras
description:
O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Sobre a Função

Desafios:

Oferecer suporte técnico especializado na operação e otimização dos processos do Preparo de Madeiras, através do mapeamento, monitoramento dos processos e gestão dos recursos, matéria-prima, sistemas e equipamentos, assegurando a produção de cavacos para o processo de produção de celulose, dentro do padrão de qualidade e eficiência, otimizando custos e minimizando desperdício, através de intervenções nos parâmetros e processos, implementação de novas tecnologias ou métodos de produção, visando a melhoria contínua no desempenho dos equipamentos e melhor qualidade da Celulose, bem como, realizar a gestão técnica dos operadores.

Principais Atividades:

  • Gerir e otimizar os processos produtivos e sistemas do Preparo de Madeiras, assegurando eficiência, qualidade e cumprimento de cronogramas;
  • Estabelecer e monitorar padrões de qualidade da madeira recebida, garantindo conformidade com especificações técnicas;
  • Analisar e aprimorar continuamente os processos de picagem e classificação de cavacos, implementando melhorias e novas tecnologias;
  • Supervisionar as operações diárias, assegurando o atendimento aos padrões de segurança, meio ambiente e qualidade;
  • Desenvolver e aplicar novas tecnologias e métodos sustentáveis para aumentar a eficiência energética e reduzir impactos ambientais;
  • Garantir conformidade com normas de segurança e regulamentações ambientais (ISOs, NRs), promovendo práticas seguras e sustentáveis;
  • Treinar e capacitar equipes de produção, fomentando a melhoria contínua e suporte técnico durante o startup da planta;
  • Gerir custos operacionais e orçamentos, monitorando despesas e propondo ações de otimização;
  • Colaborar com áreas de engenharia, manutenção, qualidade, logística e comercial em projetos de melhoria, inovação e modernização;
  • Elaborar escopos e acompanhar contratações de serviços terceirizados, assegurando qualidade, custo e segurança;
  • Participar do planejamento e execução da Parada Geral da planta, alinhando ações de manutenção e mitigação de riscos;
  • Monitorar indicadores de desempenho e propor ajustes nos processos para garantir resultados e eficiência;
  • Cumprir e promover as políticas de Segurança, Meio Ambiente, Qualidade e Compliance da empresa.

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Ensino superior em Administração, Engenharias e/ou áreas correlatas;
  • Desejável especialização em Celulose e Papel, Gestão de Projetos, Lean Manufacturing e/ou afins;
  • Conhecimento em SAP, Pacote Office e Power BI;
  • Experiência com comissionamento e startup de plantas de Celulose e/ou Papel;
  • Sólida experiência na área de Preparo de Madeiras;
  • Conhecimento sobre as propriedades da madeira, processos de preparo de madeira (descascamento, picagem, classificação), tecnologias e equipamentos utilizados na indústria de celulose;
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de análise de dados e sistemas de controle de processo;
  • Inglês e espanhol será um diferencial;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em Inocência/MS.

title: Computer Vision Engineer (AI & Retail Analytics)
description:
About Aravita

At Aravita, we are on a mission to solve one of the world's biggest challenges: fresh food waste. Our AI-powered platform uses intelligent forecasting and order recommendations to optimize fresh food operations, reduce overstocking, and minimize out-of-stock items. We are a passionate, innovative team looking for a new member to help us build this fresh-focused technology and be part of a positive change.

The Role

We are looking for a highly-motivated Computer Vision Engineer to join our AI team. This is a hands-on role where you will be responsible for building, training, and deploying the computer vision models at the heart of our next-generation retail analytics platform.

Your primary mission will be to analyze images from grocery store shelves to perform:

  • SKU & Planogram Recognition: understand what products are where on the shelf.
  • Quantity Estimation & Stockout Detection: accurately count or estimate product quantities and automatically detect empty spaces.

This role is perfect for a  problem-solver and a  quick learner who is obsessed with shipping code and seeing their models create real-world impact. The outputs you build will be a critical input for our core forecasting and logistics models.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Build & Train: design and train deep learning models for object detection, image classification, and segmentation in a complex, real-world retail environment.
  • Critically Think & Evaluate: you won't just build—you'll analyze. You will benchmark and integrate custom models (e.g., YOLO) against third-party AI services (like Google Vertex AI and Azure AI Vision) to find the best-fit solution for the problem.
  • Master the Data: work with large, imbalanced, and often challenging image datasets and develop clever strategies for data augmentation and annotation.
  • Collaborate & Deploy: work closely with our data science and engineering teams to deploy your models into a scalable production environment.

Our Ideal Candidate...

  • Is a  problem-solver first . You are excited by a complex challenge and have the critical thinking skills to break it down.
  • Is a  fast learner . You might not know every tool on day one, but you have the fundamentals and drive to learn them quickly.
  • Is  hands-on and results-oriented . You have a bias for action and a passion for building and shipping solutions.
  • Has strong  Python skills and hands-on experience with a major ML framework like  PyTorch or  TensorFlow .
  • Has a solid understanding of computer vision principles and deep learning models (e.g., CNNs, object detection, transfer learning).

What You'll Work With (And Learn)

This is a fantastic opportunity to get hands-on experience with a state-of-the-art stack.  You don't need to be an expert in all of these today, but you should be excited to learn them.

  • Custom Models: YOLO, ResNet, and other SOTA architectures.
  • Core Toolkit: Python, OpenCV, PyTorch/TensorFlow.
  • Cloud AI Services: Google Vertex AI Vision & Azure AI Vision.
  • Emerging Tech: exploring multimodal LLMs for image analysis.
  • MLOps: production model deployment, monitoring, and versioning.

Bonus Points (Nice to Have)

  • A personal or academic portfolio of computer vision projects.
  • Experience with managed AI services from Google Cloud or Azure.
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and best practices.
  • Location: candidates based in or near  São Paulo, SP , are preferred for occasional team meetups.

Olímpia - SP | Unidade Cruz Alta

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

We are seeking an experienced Salesforce Sales Cloud Consultant with strong expertise in Salesforce CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) to design, develop, and implement scalable Salesforce solutions that streamline sales processes and enhance customer experience. The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to optimize business workflows, drive automation, and enable data-driven sales operations.

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field.

  • Strong understanding of Sales Cloud architecture, data model, and standard Salesforce features.
  • Expertise in Product, Pricing, Discount, and Quoting processes within CPQ.
  • Experience with Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and integration tools (MuleSoft, Boomi, etc.) preferred.
  • Salesforce Administrator, Sales Cloud Consultant, and CPQ Specialist certifications are highly desirable.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.

title: Software Engineer Site Reliability Engineer

Software Engineer Site Reliability Engineer

Location: Brazil REMOTE

About the role

The Application SRE Team supports several critical components of our foundational technologies for real-time protection, as well as our and services. We are a team of software engineers focused on improving availability, latency, performance, efficiency, change management, monitoring, emergency response, and capacity planning of the engineering stacks. If you are passionate about solving complex problems and developing cloud services at scale, we would like to speak with you.

What’s in it for you

  • You will be part of a high caliber engineering team in the exciting space of cloud tools and infrastructure management.
  • You will have an opportunity to work on hybrid cloud (Google Cloud, On-prem cloud) and work with cutting edge tooling like spinnaker, kubernetes, docker and more.
  • You will solve complex, exciting challenges and improve the depth and breadth of your technical and analytical skills
  • Your contributions to our market-leading product support will significantly impact our rapidly-growing global customer base.

What you will be doing

  • Partner closely with our development teams and product managers to architect and build features that are highly available, performant and secure
  • Develop innovative ways to smartly measure, monitor & report application and infrastructure health
  • Gain deep knowledge of our application stack
  • Experience improving the performance of micro-services and solve scaling/performance issues
  • Capacity management and planning
  • Function well in a fast-paced and rapidly-changing environment
  • Participate with the dev teams in a 24X7 on-call rotations.
  • Ability to debug and optimize code and automate routine tasks.
  • Drive efficiencies in systems and processes: capacity planning, configuration management, performance tuning, monitoring and root cause analysis.

Required skills and experience

  • 8+ years of experience troubleshooting Unix/Linux
  • Experience in managing a large-scale web operations role
  • Experience in one or more of the following: C, C++, Java, Python, Go, Perl or Ruby
  • Experience with algorithms, data structures, complexity analysis, and software design
  • Hands-on working with private or public cloud services in a highly available and scalable production environment.
  • Experience with continuous integration and deployment automation tools such as Jenkins, Ansible etc.
  • Knowledge of distributed systems a big plus
  • Previous experience working with geographically-distributed coworkers.
  • Strong interpersonal communication skills (including listening, speaking, and writing) and ability to work well in a diverse, team-focused environment with other SREs, developers, Product Managers, etc
  • Should have led teams, collaborating cross-functionally to deliver complex software features and solutions.

Education

title: Sr. Data Analytics Engineer
description:
About Credix  

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay. CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. You love to tackle big problems and break them down into smaller pieces. You will build an analytics platform that features reliable, timely and understandable metrics in a slice-and-dice format to empower other teams to make better decisions.

Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain dbt models and reliable datasets that power analytics, experiments, and decision-making across the company.

  • Enable self-service analytics by creating semantic layers and reusable data assets that let teams create insights independently.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related technical data role.
  • Deep expertise with SQL and dbt, including modular modeling, documentation, and testing.
  • Proven track record of building source-of-truth data models that support product use cases.
  • Experience with cloud data warehouses (BigQuery), semantic layers (dbt), version control (Git), and visualization tools (Hex).
  • Experience in a (credit) FinTech is a must.
  • Manager of one: structuring, and executing upon the analytics roadmap.
  • Analytical and system-oriented mindset with a strong problem-solving ability to handle complex data challenges.
  • Proactive, clear and concise communication both in Portuguese and English, ensuring alignment with cross-functional teams.
  • Anticipate business metrics needs and structure the analytics layer to ensure scalability and reusability across the entire company.
  • High attention to detail and a perfectionist approach, especially in maintaining metrics quality and integrity.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, startup environment.
  • Genuine interest/passion for disrupting the B2B credit market in Brazil by using data.
  • Collaborative mindset, working effectively with diverse stakeholders.

What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Ótima comunicação verbal e escrita

  • Proatividade e foco em resultados

  • Experiência prévia em orçamentos ou compras
  • Vivência com organização de cronogramas e relatórios

Como se candidatar:

  • Envie seu currículo e breve apresentação para com o assunto "Vaga Setor Orçamentos"
  • WhatsApp

O termo Conforme + Dominante vem do teste comportamental DISC , que classifica o comportamento das pessoas em quatro perfis principais:

  • D – Dominância
  • I – Influência
  • S – Estabilidade
  • C – Conformidade

No caso, “ Conforme + Dominante ” significa que a pessoa tem predominância nas características de Conformidade (C) , mas também apresenta traços de Dominância (D) .

Isso gera um perfil que normalmente é:

Conforme (C) – Característica principal

  • Extremamente organizada
  • Segue processos e padrões
  • Atenta a detalhes
  • Gosta de fazer certo da primeira vez
  • Preocupada com qualidade e precisão

Dominante (D) – Característica secundária

  • Decidida e assertiva
  • Focada em resultados
  • Não tem medo de assumir responsabilidades
  • Capaz de tomar decisões rápidas
  • Sabe cobrar e manter prazos

description:
Company Description

US based health technology company to be disclosed during the interview process.

Role Description

We are seeking a  Full Stack Mobile Developer to join our team and take ownership of our health monitoring mobile application. This application integrates with a Bluetooth-enabled ring pulse oximeter to collect health data throughout the night. 

The ideal candidate will be a hands-on developer with expertise in both mobile development (Flutter/Dart) and backend technologies (C#/.NET), capable of ensuring seamless device integration, reliable overnight data collection, and robust backend connectivity with Azure services. 

Responsibilities

  • Lead the development and maintenance of cross-platform mobile flagship application using Flutter/Dart for iOS and Android. 
  • Optimize Bluetooth connectivity with the ring pulse oximeter device. 
  • Address mobile battery optimization challenges to guarantee reliable overnight data collection. 
  • Introduce in app features to provide payments, notifications, and support (chat)
  • Manage the release process for both the Apple App Store and Google Play Store. 
  • Collaborate with backend developers on Azure-hosted .NET services, contributing to backend development when required. 
  • Ensure compliance with health data security and privacy standards. 
  • Work independently while providing technical leadership within the team. 

Qualifications

  • Advanced English communication skills (C1 level), both written and spoken.
  • 7+ years of professional software development experience, with strong expertise in mobile development. 
  • Proven experience with  Flutter/Dart for cross-platform mobile applications. 
  • Working knowledge of  C# and .NET , with the ability to contribute to backend services. 
  • Deep understanding of  Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) implementation. 
  • Experience with  mobile battery optimization techniques for background processes. 
  • Successful track record of publishing and maintaining apps in the App Store and Google Play. 
  • Experience integrating with  Microsoft Azure services . 
  • Familiarity with  Firebase (Authentication, Crashlytics, Analytics),  Sentry , and  PostHog . 
  • Familiarity with in-app payment systems (such as Authorize.net, Stripe)
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail. 
  • Prior experience in health or medical app development is a plus.

title: Especialista de RH
description:
No Grupo Iberostar estamos à procura de um profissional para atuar como Especialista de Recursos Humanos para se juntar à nossa equipe em Praia do Forte . Antes de saber mais sobre a vaga, achamos relevante compartilhar algumas informações sobre o Grupo Iberostar:

  • Somos uma empresa 100% familiar (mais concretamente, uma família de mais de 30.000 colaboradores).
  • Estamos presentes em 35 países e a nossa sede é em Palma de Maiorca.
  • Os nossos valores (Paixão, Responsabilidade, Transparência, Criatividade e Humildade) são muito importantes para nós e todas as nossas ações estão alinhadas com eles.
  • Somos pioneiros no turismo sustentável (veja o nosso movimento Wave of Change para saber mais).

Se isto lhe parece interessante... este pode ser o lugar certo para você! :)

Quais serão suas principais funções?

Recrutamento e Seleção

  • Condução e coordenação de processos seletivos para cargos de gerência e vice-diretoria.
  • Auxílio e suporte estratégico às equipes de RH e gestão nas atividades de recrutamento e seleção.
  • Garantia do alinhamento dos processos de seleção com os objetivos organizacionais.

Treinamento e Desenvolvimento

  • Análise de Necessidades de Treinamento: Realizar análise aprofundada de lacunas de habilidades, conduzir entrevistas e analisar dados de desempenho para identificar necessidades e desenvolver planos de ação.
  • Desenvolvimento de Programas de Treinamento: Ser responsável pelo processo de Indução de novos colaboradores, projetar e implementar programas personalizados (como o PDL), criar conteúdos inovadores (incluindo manuais e vídeos) e adotar metodologias como gamificação e simulações.
  • Implementação de Treinamentos: Coordenar a logística, facilitar os treinamentos e fornecer feedback contínuo.
  • Avaliação e Relatórios: Medir a eficácia dos programas utilizando KPIs, analisar dados e apresentar relatórios detalhados sobre o impacto nos objetivos organizacionais.

Programas e Gestão de Pessoas

  • Programa de Acompanhamento de Novos Colaboradores: Acompanhar o desempenho, fornecer suporte e feedback regular, e avaliar periodicamente a eficácia do programa de integração.
  • Programa de Indução (onboarding)
  • Programas do RH (Ouvidoria e Comitê da Diversidade): Gerenciar e analisar demandas da ouvidoria (RH com Você!), garantindo confidencialidade e elaborando relatórios de melhorias, e acompanhar as reuniões do Comitê da Diversidade.
  • Gestão de Desligamento e Retenção: Conduzir entrevistas de desligamento para análise de fatores de saída e desenvolver/implementar estratégias de retenção de talentos e engajamento.
  • Desenvolvimento de Pessoas e Gestão de Desempenho: Mapear necessidades de T&D, conduzir programas de desenvolvimento de carreira e atuar como consultor estratégico para a liderança.
  • Indicadores de Desempenho e Relatórios: Acompanhar KPIs de recrutamento, seleção, desenvolvimento e retenção, e gerar relatórios analíticos para a liderança.

O que é necessário para ter sucesso nesta função?

A pessoa ideal para este cargo possui excelentes habilidades de trabalho em equipe, é um bom comunicador. Tem capacidade de trabalhar com autonomia e rapidez na execução de processos. Possui capacidade de análise, habilidade de estruturar, sintetizar o conteúdo e montar apresentações harmoniosas e impactantes. É flexível e adaptável às novas circunstâncias da empresa e às diferentes mudanças organizacionais e possuir também as seguintes competências:

  • Formação: Graduação Psicologia
  • Experiência: De 3 a 4 anos em funções similares

title: Enablement Process & Curriculum Operations Manager
description:
Position Enablement Process & Curriculum Operations Manager 

Organization SalesSparx LLC 

Location Latin America, EMEA (Remote) 

Contract Type Full-time 

We Are SalesSparx – This Is What We Do  

SalesSparx, founded in 2015, is a boutique consulting firm on a mission to accelerate healthcare innovation. We help high-growth companies, especially those selling technology and services to health systems, scale smarter and faster. Our focus is go-to-market (GTM) strategy, sales enablement, and training execution. 

We’re not just advisors, we’re builders, operators, and trusted partners to the C-suite. At SalesSparx, you’ll get a front-row seat to how real healthcare business gets done, working directly with CEOs, founders, and executive teams. 

We operate in a high-performance, client-first environment where team members are empowered to take ownership, think strategically, and drive outcomes. Whether you're managing projects, leading accounts, or building internal capabilities, your work will shape the growth trajectory of companies at the forefront of healthcare transformation. 

We value curiosity, accountability, and execution. If you thrive in fast-paced settings, enjoy solving complex problems, and want to accelerate your career alongside a team that’s redefining how healthcare companies go to market, this is the place to do it. 

SalesSparx by the Numbers  

  • Have served over 100 healthcare software, consulting and technology firms 
  • 10K+ hours of sales best practice research 
  • $1B+ client bookings 
  • SVS Process used to manage 50K+ sales opportunities per year 
  • 9.9/10 Client Net Promoter Score 
  • Published Light Your Sales FUSE in 2023, the only Healthcare-focused Sales Acceleration Guide in the industry 

Opportunity  

The Enablement Process & Curriculum Operations Manager leads the operational backbone behind SalesSparx’s internal training systems, documentation structure, and methodology governance. 

This professional maintains the single source of truth for internal processes, training curricula, templates, and onboarding structures. They ensure consultants follow the right learning paths, have access to accurate materials, and that our methodologies (SVS, FUSE GTM, consulting workflows) remain organized, structured, and current. 

This is a hands-on, detail-oriented role focused on execution, documentation discipline, and content operations, in additional to management responsibilities. In the short term this person will develop the content to support our operational process and over time will build up its own team. 

What You’ll Do  

Process Documentation & Knowledge Extraction  

  • Interview team members, shadow workflows, and extract tribal knowledge. 
  • Translate informal processes into clear documentation, SOPs, and structured modules. 
  • Maintain an organized, version-controlled process repository. 
  • Ensure internal methodologies (SVS, FUSE GTM, consulting workflows) are accurately documented and regularly updated. 

Template Governance & Content Maintenance  

  • Own the lifecycle and organization of: SVS materials, Go-to-Market assets and Internal consulting templates 
  • Audit and update templates on a defined cadence. 
  • Enforce consistency, version control, and internal standards for all materials. 
  • Maintain a centralized template library that is easy for consultants to access and navigate. 

Training Curriculum & LMS Development  

  • Convert existing training materials into structured LMS modules. 
  • Build quizzes, assessments, practice exercises, and progress tracking workflows. 
  • Maintain curriculum versions and ensure training content remains aligned to current methodology. 
  • Support training execution logistics (materials prep, assignments, communications). 

Onboarding Coordination  

  • Build a structured onboarding flow for new consultants. 
  • Ensure every new hire follows the correct learning path and completes required modules. 
  • Track onboarding progress and report on readiness or gaps. 
  • Provide execution support to the team members leading training sessions. 

Learning Path Compliance & Monitoring  

  • Track consultant participation in learning paths. 
  • Follow up on incomplete modules and escalate when needed. 
  • Maintain dashboards or tracking sheets for enablement completion. 
  • Ensure training compliance is consistently monitored and documented. 

Who We’re Looking For  

Education  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Administration, Business, Education, Sales, Communications, or related fields. 
  • Master’s degree preferred (Education, Instructional Design, Adult Learning, Curriculum & Instruction, or similar). 

Experience  

  • Experience on training Management Consultants is required.
  • Experience on working in a Management Consulting firm is required
  • 5+ years in roles such as: Training Coordinator, Instructional Design Specialist, Enablement Coordinator, Curriculum Development Assistant, Knowledge Management Specialist, or Process Documentation/PMO Support. 
  • Experience on training Management Consultants is required.
  • Experience building training materials, documenting processes, and maintaining structured content repositories. 
  • Familiarity with LMS platforms, learning paths, assessments, and completion tracking. 
  • Experience in process-driven, documentation-heavy environments. 
  • No prior healthcare experience required. 

Skills  

  • Fluent written and spoken English. 
  • Capable to work on EST hours. 
  • Strong organizational discipline in a fully remote environment. 
  • Ability to extract insights from SMEs and convert them into structured content. 
  • Comfort building onboarding flows, training assets, and learning materials. 
  • Proficiency with: 
  • Documentation tools (SharePoint, Google Drive, etc.) 
  • LMS or course-authoring tools 
  • Project management tools (Asana) 
  • Basic design/editing platforms (Canva, PowerPoint) 
  • Strong attention to detail, consistency, and version control. 
  • Ability to handle confidential information with professionalism and discretion. 

Compensation  

  • Competitive Base Salary
  • Generous Bonus Package

title: Líder florestal
description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

title: Engenheiro de controle

This role is for a position within the Advanced Process Control (APC) department. The APC department works with mine sites around the world (both remotely and on site) to deploy and integrate optimization solutions for the benefit of clients and industry. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys travelling and has an analytical mind.

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.

Why Join Us

Join a dynamic team where you will be directly involved in high-impact strategic projects that shape the future of our games and brand. Benefit from personalized mentorship and continuous learning opportunities through close collaboration with our experienced management team. Your creativity and insights will truly matter in an environment that prioritizes your professional growth.

title: Game Compliance e Development Consultant
description:
SOBRE A NÓS:

A DigiPlus Interactive Corp., líder em entretenimento digital nas Filipinas, chegou ao Brasil! Iniciamos nossas operações no Brasil em 2025 com o lançamento oficial da DigiPlus Brasil Interactive Ltda., e já estamos 100% licenciados para oferecer experiências inovadoras no mercado de iGaming.

Estamos trazendo o sucesso de plataformas renomadas como a BingoPlus para criar novas oportunidades e experiências incríveis para os brasileiros.

SOBRE A ATUAÇÃO DE CONSULTORIA:

Contrato PJ temporário (3 meses) podendo ser extendido, necessário inglês avançado para atuação global.

Irá fornecer consultoria especializada para garantir que os jogos proprietários da DigiPlus (bingo, jogos instantâneos e jogos esportivos) estejam em total conformidade com as regulamentações de jogos brasileiras e tecnicamente prontos para certificação por laboratórios acreditados (GLI, BMM, eCOGRA, etc.). Atuará na intermediação entre a interpretação da regulamentação, a validação matemática e a localização para o Brasil, possibilitando uma rápida implementação comercial.

ENTREGÁVEIS ESPERADOS DA CONSULTORIA:

Alinhamento com Regulamentações e Certificações

  • Auditar jogos proprietários existentes para verificar a conformidade com as Portarias 722, 1207 e regulamentações brasileiras correlatas.
  • Desenvolver e entregar um Relatório de Avaliação de Conformidade, resumindo as lacunas e as adaptações necessárias.
  • Elaborar ou revisar a documentação técnica para submissão aos laboratórios de certificação (regras, metodologia de RNG, tabelas de RTP, lógica de pagamento).
  • Recomendar melhorias no fluxo de trabalho para agilizar a preparação para a certificação e minimizar retrabalho.

Matemática e Validação de Jogos

  • Revisar e validar os modelos matemáticos do jogo: RTP, volatilidade, curvas de pagamento e lógica de probabilidade.
  • Executar ou supervisionar simulações e testes A/B para verificar os resultados matemáticos esperados.
  • Produzir um Resumo de Validação Matemática, identificando inconsistências, riscos e ajustes recomendados.

Localização e Adaptação ao Mercado

  • Avaliar os recursos do jogo quanto à adequação cultural e comportamental ao mercado brasileiro (visuais, UX, ritmo e terminologia).
  • Fornecer um Documento de Diretrizes de Localização que descreva os ajustes necessários para melhorar o engajamento do usuário e a conformidade.
  • Aconselhar sobre ajustes nas estruturas de prêmios, equilíbrio de dificuldade e preços para padrões de jogadores locais.

Suporte Interfuncional

  • Atuar como consultor regulatório e técnico para as equipes de produto, design e conformidade.
  • Traduzir os requisitos técnicos de conformidade em tarefas de desenvolvimento acionáveis.
  • Participar de reuniões de revisão quinzenais e fornecer feedback por escrito sobre os protótipos.

RESULTADOS ESPERADOS:

  • Relatório de Avaliação de Conformidade (por linha de produto).
  • Resumo e recomendações da Validação Matemática.
  • Documento com Diretrizes de Localização.
  • Pacote de documentação técnica pronto para submissão ao laboratório de certificação.
  • Apresentação final resumindo os principais riscos, melhorias e próximos passos.

REQUITOS NECESSÁRIOS:

  • Experiência comprovada em conformidade, certificação e validação matemática (RTP, RNG e volatilidade) de jogos.
  • Familiaridade com a regulamentação brasileira de iGaming e processos de certificação de laboratórios.
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de documentação.
  • Experiência em trabalho multifuncional com estúdios, engenheiros e equipes de conformidade.
  • Inglês Avançado (necessário para lidar com Stakeholders global)

O QUE VOCÊ VAI ENCONTRAR AQUI:

  • Contrato PJ com remuneração compatível com o mercado de iGaming;
  • Ambiente global e inovador do mercado de Igaming;

title: SAP Technical Cutover Manager
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for SAP Technical Cutover Manager who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

'Key Responsibilities

Co-lead end-to-end SAP technical activities with K-C leadership and PMO to guide the project team’s efforts to successfully go-live with localization and deployment of a previously built greenfield global template of SAP S/4HANA in the RISE private cloud in MS Azure to K-C business segments in Asia.• Lead and coordinate technical SAP localization and deployment tasks throughout the life of the project including technical landscape readiness, completion of remaining SAP build configuration and development activities and completion of technical activities to localize SAP S/4HANA according to regional requirements in Asia.• Collaborate with K-C leadership, project managers, functional leads, technical platform leads, SAP developers, and business stakeholders to complete all technical activities in a pre-planned and pre-defined sequence to ensure alignment with project goals, milestones and specific deliverables.• Manage and document traceability between technical requirements, business requirements, completion of deliverables that meet requirements, testing activities and defect resolution through go-live and into hypercare.• Provide leadership and mentorship to other cutover business and technical team members and adhere to SAP S/4HANA cutover best practices and standards.

Track and report technical cutover preparation and progress, risks, actions, issues and decisions to project leadership through the Microsoft Asure DevOps (ADO) project management tool, meetings, emails and project documents.

5+ years of experience in SAP technical cutover management, with at least 5 years in a technical cutover or related technical leadership role.

Strong understanding of SAP modules (e.g., FI/CO, MM, SD, PP, WM, BW and more) and their integration points.

Prior hands-on experience with SAP configuration, development, implementation troubleshooting and resolution of technical defects is required for this Technical Cutover Manager to manage all technical activities of other technical cutover resources.

Excellent communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills.

Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities.

Preferred Skills

Experience with prior projects with a successful cutover to go-live with SAP S/4HANA.

Familiarity with Agile and hybrid waterfall and Agile project methodologies.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Previdência Privada; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Senior Training Manager
description:
Job Summary:

The Learning Expert is responsible for applying employee training programs, conducting training needs analysis, and developing engaging learning content. This role ensures smooth training logistics, maintains training records, and supports the continuous improvement of L&D initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:

1 . Training Program Application

  • Schedule, organize, and deliver training programs through lectures, workshops, videos, e-learning, and blended formats.
  • Apply training logistics, including scheduling, venue bookings, facilitator coordination, and employee enrollment.
  • Maintain and update the Learning Management System (LMS) and training records.
  • Handle administrative duties such as tracking attendance, sending reminders, and managing training budgets.

2. New Employee Orientation Facilitation

  • Design, update, and facilitate engaging onboarding programs for new hires.
  • Collaborate with HR and department leaders to ensure a smooth transition for new employees.
  • Continuously improve trainings based on feedback and evolving company needs.

3. Training Needs Analysis & Evaluation

  • Conduct surveys, interviews, and performance assessments to identify skill gaps.
  • Monitor and evaluate training effectiveness through feedback, quizzes, and KPIs (e.g., completion rates, performance improvement).
  • Adjust training programs based on data insights to enhance engagement and knowledge retention.

4. Content & Training Material Development

  • Create and update training manuals, guides, job aids, and digital resources for employee learning.
  • Develop interactive content (e-learning modules, videos, quizzes, presentations).
  • Ensure materials comply with company policies and industry standards.

5. Training Delivery & Facilitation

  • Conduct engaging live and virtual training sessions for employees at all levels.
  • Use diverse training methods (role-playing, simulations, discussions) to maximize learning.
  • Provide post-training support to reinforce key concepts.

6. Stakeholder Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Partner with department heads to align training with business goals.
  • Support ad-hoc Learning initiatives (leadership development, new employees training, etc.).
  • Promote a culture of continuous learning through newsletters, LMS updates, and recognition programs.

Qualifications & Skills:

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in HR, Organizational Development, Education, or related field.
  • Experience: 7+ years in Learning, training application, or HR, including facilitation and content creation.
  • Language Proficiency: Fluent in English (written and spoken).
  • Technical Skills (Preferred/Nice-to-Have): Familiarity with LMS platforms and e-learning tools and knowledge of MS Office (PowerPoint, Excel) and video training software.
  • Soft Skills: Strong organizational and project management abilities, Engaging facilitator with excellent presentation and communication skills. Analytical mindset to assess training effectiveness and adapt programs.

***Work model: In-office 5x a week.

description:

Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan , a global giant in the delivery sector, and it's on an ambitious mission: to revolutionize the delivery of food and consumer goods worldwide. Our motto is simple yet powerful: “We help people eat better, live better.” Guided by this principle, we bring innovation and technology to the global stage. About the Role:

We are seeking a Senior Media Manager to lead media negotiations and strategy for offline, online channels and events management. You will be responsible for the end-to-end media and events process - from negotiation and planning to execution and post-campaign analysis - ensuring maximum ROI and brand impact for our food delivery technology platform.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Lead negotiations with media partners and agencies across digital and traditional channels, securing optimal terms and value for the brand.
  • Develop and execute integrated media strategies, balancing online (social, display, programmatic, influencers, etc.), offline (TV, radio, OOH, print) and events investments.
  • Using data analytics, determine the best media outlet mix and optimize our campaigns accordingly. If necessary, build models to understand and improve performance.
  • Oversee media planning, buying, and implementation, ensuring alignment with business objectives and campaign goals.
  • Monitor media performance, analyze campaign results, and present actionable insights to stakeholders for continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate with internal teams (social strategy, brand, business intelligence) and external partners to optimize media mix and drive business growth.
  • Manage media budgets, ensuring efficient allocation and cost control throughout negotiation and execution phases.

  • Vivência prévia em projetos de S/4HANA (conversão, migração, preparação ou fases de testes – parcial ou completa).

  • Experiência com integração de HCM com outros sistemas SAP e corporativos.

Diferenciais:

title: Analista de Suprimentos COE
description:
Missão: Atuar como protagonista na estruturação, evolução e sustentação da jornada de SRM (Supplier Relationship Management) , com foco em estratégia, governança e relacionamento , promovendo integração entre MDM, Compras/Gestão de Categorias e Fornecedores . O cargo exige visão analítica, capacidade de construção de metodologias e influência para consolidar práticas consistentes de gestão de fornecedores em toda a organização.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Construir, revisar e treinar diretrizes de SRM (políticas, SOPs, instruções e frameworks) garantindo padronização e alinhamento estratégico entre BU’s.
  • Definir metodologias de risco e segmentação de fornecedores , considerando critérios financeiros, de dependência, sustentabilidade e ESG, em parceria com as áreas de MDM e Gestão de Categorias.
  • Estruturar e monitorar o modelo de avaliação anual de performance , definindo indicadores, dashboards e metodologias alinhadas a normas ISO e melhores práticas globais.
  • Desenvolver programas estruturados de capacitação e inovação junto a fornecedores estratégicos, fortalecendo parcerias de longo prazo.
  • Promover fóruns de governança e alinhamento estratégico , atuando como ponto focal para integração entre áreas internas, MDM, Gestão de Categorias e Fornecedores.
  • Elaborar relatórios e KPIs estruturados de monitoramento de SRM, assegurando a integridade de dados em parceria com MDM e o uso efetivo pelas áreas de Compras e Categorias.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de melhoria contínua e harmonização de processos de Suprimentos (Req-to-Pay, compliance e controles internos), aplicando metodologias Lean, Kaizen e ferramentas digitais.
  • Atuar como facilitador de auditorias, compliance e riscos , garantindo a governança do relacionamento com fornecedores críticos.

Formação e Experiência

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Engenharias, Economia, Logística ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação em Supply Chain, Governança ou Gestão de Riscos (desejável).
  • Experiência em Suprimentos, Governança, SRM ou Gestão de Riscos em empresas de médio/grande porte.
  • Vivência com processos de homologação, qualificação e desenvolvimento de fornecedores , com interface direta com compliance e categorias.
  • Experiência com auditorias e projetos de eficiência operacional será diferencial.

Conhecimentos e Habilidades Técnicas

  • Gestão de SRM: metodologias de segmentação, avaliação de performance, desenvolvimento e inovação com fornecedores .
  • Ferramentas de melhoria contínua: VSM, Lean, Kaizen, 6S, Daily Management .
  • Controles internos e gestão de riscos (ERM) aplicados a fornecedores e compras.
  • Domínio de ERP (SAP ECC / S4 Hana) e plataformas de e-Procurement (Ariba, IBID).
  • Excel avançado; Power BI desejável.
  • Comunicação clara e capacidade de influência transversal.

title: Enterprise Architect
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!

Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for a Enterprise Architect , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, hybrid , in the city of São Paulo .

In this role you will:

The Enterprise Architect will be centrally responsible for the strategic definition and implementation of Canada's enterprise architecture, working from the design and governance of systems to the integration of technological platforms and operational mining processes. Its mission is to translate business objectives into modern, secure and scalable architectures, aligned with international standards and the automation, sustainability and innovation goals of the group.

This professional will work in partnership with the global Enterprise Architect and cross-functional areas (IT, Operations, Engineering, ESG), ensuring that each solution offers efficient integration between on-premises, cloud, and industrial automation environments. He will have a profound influence on technology decisions, playing an advisory role with Canadian and Brazilian leadership, promoting a collaborative, innovative and results-oriented environment.

To succeed, you must demonstrate strategic vision, technical leadership, exceptional intercultural communication skills, and mastery of regulatory requirements in both Canada and Brazil.

Main Responsibilities

  • Define, document and evolve integrated Enterprise Architecture models (business, applications, data, technology), using frameworks such as TOGAF/ArchiMate and aligning with the strategic demands of mining, sustainability and digital transformation.
  • Act as a technical reference, leading cross-functional teams, promoting the consolidation of solutions between IT, OT and industrial automation, ensuring adherence to global corporate standards.
  • Evaluate and validate new technologies, platforms, services and methods (Cloud, Edge Computing, Digital Twins, IoT, Analytics, Cybersecurity), always considering the best practices in the mineral and natural resources sector.
  • Develop and maintain architectural criteria that prioritize security, regulatory compliance (LGPD, PIPEDA, GDPR), performance, sustainability and operational integration between Canada and Brazil.
  • Prepare detailed documentation (LLD/HLD, reference architectures, guidelines), transferring knowledge and mentoring technical and business teams both locally and internationally.
  • Lead communication between technical, operations, engineering, and global leaders, promoting efficient collaboration and respecting cultural differences.
  • Continuously analyze technological, regulatory and business trends, proposing standards and improvements that position as an international reference in sustainable and digital mining.
  • Participate directly in the supplier selection/merger processes, prioritizing interoperability, innovation and return on investment in critical projects.

Requirements and Competencies

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills)

  • Proven experience (minimum of 8 years in IT, with at least 5 as an enterprise architect or similar strategic role in Large Enterprise or mining/resources).
  • Deep knowledge of the mineral, energy or industrial sector, preferably previous experience in large global operations (e.g., Petrobras, Rio Tinto, Barrick Gold, Anglo American).
  • Mastery of the main enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF: Practitioner, ArchiMate, Zachman, DAMA-DMBOK).
  • Excellence in the use of cloud technologies (Azure, AWS, GCP) and data platforms, cross-system integration (ERP SAP/Oracle, SCADA, IIoT, Data Lake, Data Warehouse, Lakehouse).
  • Ability to design hybrid architectures (on-premises, cloud, edge), industrial data integration (sensing, automation, dashboards, analytics).
  • Strong performance in compliance, industrial cybersecurity (OT/IT Convergence), data protection, disaster recovery and business continuity.
  • Experience in multinational/cross-border projects, especially Brazil-Canada.
  • Fluent English (technical communication, executive meetings, documentation), advanced Portuguese is a strategic differential for integration between teams.

Soft Skills

  • Advanced communication skills, capable of transmitting complex technical concepts to different audiences (executives, engineers, IT, business).
  • Global strategic vision, aligning local and global initiatives with corporate objectives in sustainable mining, innovation and automation.
  • Analytical and solution-oriented thinking, with high ability to navigate complex, multifunctional and multicultural environments.
  • Collaborative leadership – mentoring, consensus building, influence without direct authority, and excellent internal/external networking skills.
  • Management of priorities, organization and resilience in the face of multiple parallel projects and ad-hoc demands.
  • Absolute focus on results, delivering tangible value for operation, innovation and sustainability.

Differentials / Nice to Have:

  • TOGAF (Expert) certification, AWS/Azure/GCP Solution Architect, CISA, PMP/Agile, specializations in ESG, digital mining, cyber OT/IT.
  • Hands-on experience with emerging platforms: Digital Twins, AI/ML/Ops, real-time streaming (Kafka, Spark Streaming, Flink), infrastructures as code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
  • Experience in due diligence processes, merger & acquisition, integration of multi-company systems.
  • Active participation in architecture forums, mining, global events, technical publications or international presentations.
  • Background with SAP, Oracle, SIEMENS, Rockwell, GE Predix, Azure IoT/Edge/Analytics solutions, sustainability frameworks and ESG reporting.

Expected Skills & Deliverables, Impact:

  • Align the needs of global business, Canada and Brazil with the vision of enterprise architecture and technological roadmap.
  • Ensure that all solutions meet requirements for scalability, security, performance, regulatory compliance and operational excellence.
  • To be an agent of transformation and innovation, proposing disruptive solutions to digital and operational challenges in the mining sector.
  • Mentor and develop technical capacity of the teams, promoting architecture culture, documentation and standardization.
  • Lead the preparation and presentation of business cases, technical justifications and architectural alternatives to senior executives and regional and global boards.
  • Organize, sustain and evolve architecture governance, support strategic decisions and ensure the permanent alignment of solutions with business objectives and international compliance.

Additional Comments:

This is a key role in Canada's technological and cultural transformation, requiring active action in multicultural environments, with flexibility for travel, meetings in different time zones and continuous adaptation to trends in the mining sector and global architecture. The presence of fluent English is mandatory, while mastery of Portuguese enhances Brazil-Canada integration, directly impacting the success of the project. Technical certifications, previous experience in operations, participation in modernization/digitalization initiatives and innovative mindset will be major differentials in the selection process.
